### Regression Final Group Project: Household Size Prediction

## Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mlr3verse)
library(ggplot2)
library(glmnet)
library(randomForest)
library(mgcv)
future::plan("sequential")

set.seed(67)
```


## Load the Data
```{r}
survey <- read_csv("survey_train_test.csv")
amazon_purchases <- read_csv("amazon-purchases.csv")
```


## Adding Features
```{r}
# categorize amazon categories into 8 groups 
categorize_product <- function(cat, title) {
  cat   <- ifelse(is.na(cat), "", cat)    
  title <- ifelse(is.na(title), "", title)
  
  case_when(
    str_detect(cat, "GROCERY|FOOD|SNACK")                          ~ "grocery",
    str_detect(cat, "BABY|DIAPER|TODDLER|INFANT")                  ~ "baby",
    str_detect(cat, "TOY|GAME")                                    ~ "kids",
    str_detect(cat, "PET")                                         ~ "pet",
    str_detect(cat, "BOOK")                                        ~ "book",
    str_detect(cat, "ELECTRONIC|COMPUTER|TABLET|PHONE|HEADPHONES") ~ "electronics",
    str_detect(cat, "CLOTH|APPAREL|SHOE")                          ~ "apparel",
    TRUE                                                           ~ "other"
  )
}


# create new columns for every purchase row in the Amazon dataset
amazon_purchases <- amazon_purchases %>%
  mutate(
    OrderDate_parsed = ymd(`Order Date`),
    prod_group = categorize_product(Category, Title),
    line_spend = `Purchase Price Per Unit` * Quantity,
    has_pack_keywords = str_detect(tolower(Title), "pack|set|mult|combo"),
    is_consumable = `Purchase Price Per Unit` < 10 & Category %in% c("GROCERY", "HOUSEHOLD"),
    
    has_toiletries = str_detect(tolower(Title), "toilet|shampoo|soap|paper"),
    has_cleaning   = str_detect(tolower(Title), "cleaner|detergent|bleach|trash|wipe"),
    has_laundry    = str_detect(tolower(Title), "detergent|softener|stain")
  )

# customer level summary
purchase_summary <- amazon_purchases %>%
  group_by(`Survey ResponseID`) %>%
  summarize(
    total_purchases  = n(),                           
    total_spending   = sum(line_spend, na.rm = TRUE), 
    total_quantity   = sum(Quantity, na.rm = TRUE),   
    
    avg_price    = mean(`Purchase Price Per Unit`, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_price = median(`Purchase Price Per Unit`, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price    = max(`Purchase Price Per Unit`, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_price    = min(`Purchase Price Per Unit`, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_std    = sd(`Purchase Price Per Unit`, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_range  = max(`Purchase Price Per Unit`, na.rm = TRUE) - 
                   min(`Purchase Price Per Unit`, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    avg_quantity = mean(Quantity, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_quantity = max(Quantity, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_quantity = min(Quantity, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    unique_categories = n_distinct(Category, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_top_category  = {
      cat_table <- table(Category[!is.na(Category)])
      if (length(cat_table) > 0) max(cat_table) / n() else NA_real_
    },
    
    n_unique_asins   = n_distinct(`ASIN/ISBN (Product Code)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_repeat_asins   = sum(duplicated(`ASIN/ISBN (Product Code)`) > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    repeat_asin_rate = ifelse(n_unique_asins > 0, n_repeat_asins / n_unique_asins, 0),
 
    n_pack_orders = sum(has_pack_keywords, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_bulk_orders = sum(Quantity >= 5, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_multi_item_orders = sum(Quantity >= 2, na.rm = TRUE),

    n_consumables           = sum(is_consumable, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_toiletries            = sum(has_toiletries, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_cleaning              = sum(has_cleaning, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_laundry               = sum(has_laundry, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_household_maintenance = n_cleaning + n_laundry,
    
    first_date = suppressWarnings(min(OrderDate_parsed, na.rm = TRUE)),
    last_date  = suppressWarnings(max(OrderDate_parsed, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    spend_grocery  = sum(line_spend[prod_group == "grocery"], na.rm = TRUE),
    spend_baby     = sum(line_spend[prod_group == "baby"], na.rm = TRUE),
    spend_kids     = sum(line_spend[prod_group == "kids"], na.rm = TRUE),
    spend_pet      = sum(line_spend[prod_group == "pet"], na.rm = TRUE),
    spend_book     = sum(line_spend[prod_group == "book"], na.rm = TRUE),
    spend_elec     = sum(line_spend[prod_group == "electronics"], na.rm = TRUE),
    spend_apparel  = sum(line_spend[prod_group == "apparel"], na.rm = TRUE),
    spend_other    = sum(line_spend[prod_group == "other"], na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
mutate(

    purchase_days_span = ifelse(
      is.finite(first_date) & is.finite(last_date),
      as.numeric(difftime(last_date, first_date, units = "days")),
      0
    ),
    purchases_per_day       = total_purchases / pmax(purchase_days_span, 1),
    spending_per_day        = total_spending / pmax(purchase_days_span, 1),
    avg_days_between_orders = purchase_days_span / pmax(total_purchases - 1, 1),
    
    spending_per_purchase = total_spending / pmax(total_purchases, 1),

    log_total_spending  = log1p(total_spending),
    log_total_purchases = log1p(total_purchases),
    log_avg_price       = log1p(avg_price),

    purchase_diversity = unique_categories / pmax(total_purchases, 1),
    
    pct_spend_grocery = spend_grocery / pmax(total_spending, 1),
    pct_spend_baby    = spend_baby / pmax(total_spending, 1),
    pct_spend_kids    = spend_kids / pmax(total_spending, 1),
    pct_spend_pet     = spend_pet / pmax(total_spending, 1),
    pct_spend_elec    = spend_elec / pmax(total_spending, 1),
    pct_spend_book    = spend_book / pmax(total_spending, 1),
    pct_spend_apparel = spend_apparel / pmax(total_spending, 1),
    pct_spend_other   = spend_other / pmax(total_spending, 1),
    
    pct_bulk_orders = n_bulk_orders / pmax(total_purchases, 1),
    pct_multi_item  = n_multi_item_orders / pmax(total_purchases, 1),
    pct_pack_orders = n_pack_orders / pmax(total_purchases, 1),
    
    family_spending = pct_spend_baby + pct_spend_kids + pct_spend_grocery,
    
    consumables_per_month = n_consumables / pmax(purchase_days_span / 30, 1)
  ) %>%

  select(-first_date, -last_date)

purchase_summary <- purchase_summary %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric),
                ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .x)))

```

```{r}
# survey demographics 
survey_clean <- survey %>%
  mutate(
    Q.demos.gender = factor(Q.demos.gender),
    Q.demos.state  = factor(Q.demos.state)
  )
full_data <- survey_clean %>%
  left_join(
    purchase_summary,
    by = c("Survey.ResponseID" = "Survey ResponseID")
  )
full_data <- full_data %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric),
                ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .x)))
full_data <- full_data %>%
  mutate(
    orders_x_diversity  = total_purchases * purchase_diversity,
    logspend_x_pct_baby = log_total_spending * pct_spend_baby,
    logpurch_x_pct_kids = log_total_purchases * pct_spend_kids,
    spendday_x_pct_groc = spending_per_day * pct_spend_grocery,
    gender_x_spend_bin = interaction(
      Q.demos.gender,
      cut_number(log_total_spending, 3),
      drop = TRUE
    ),
    
    state_x_kids_bin = interaction(
      Q.demos.state,
      cut_number(pct_spend_kids, 3),
      drop = TRUE
    )
  )
```


## Split the Train / Test Data
```{r}
train_data <- full_data %>% filter(test == 0)
test_data <- full_data %>% filter(test == 1)

train_complete <- train_data %>%
filter(!is.na(Q.amazon.use.hh.size.num))
```


## Trimmed/Final Model Building 

```{r}
# trimmed features
feature_cols_final <- c(
  "Q.demos.gender", "Q.demos.state",
  "logpurch_x_pct_kids", "logspend_x_pct_baby",
  "purchase_days_span", "spending_per_day",
  "pct_spend_baby", "pct_spend_kids", "pct_spend_elec",
  "pct_spend_grocery", "pct_spend_pet",
  "family_spending", "pct_multi_item", "pct_top_category",
  "purchase_diversity", "median_price",
  "pct_pack_orders", "n_household_maintenance",
  "repeat_asin_rate", "n_unique_asins",
  "log_total_spending"
)

train_for_task_final <- train_complete %>%
  select(Q.amazon.use.hh.size.num, all_of(feature_cols_final))

tsk_household_final <- as_task_regr(
  train_for_task_final,
  target = "Q.amazon.use.hh.size.num",
  id     = "household_size_final"
)

test_for_pred_final <- test_data %>%
  select(Survey.ResponseID, all_of(feature_cols_final))

set.seed(67)
resampling <- rsmp("cv", folds = 5)

# ridge model
set.seed(67)
lrn_ridge_final <- as_learner(
  po("encode", method = "one-hot") %>>%
  po("imputemean") %>>%
    lrn(
      "regr.cv_glmnet",
      alpha       = 0,
      lambda      = 10^seq(from = -4, to = 2, by = 0.05),
      standardize = TRUE
    )
)

set.seed(67)
rr_ridge_final <- resample(
  task       = tsk_household_final,
  learner    = lrn_ridge_final,
  resampling = resampling
)

ridge_rmse_final <- rr_ridge_final$aggregate(msr("regr.rmse"))
print(paste("Ridge (final features) CV RMSE:", ridge_rmse_final))

# lasso model
set.seed(67)
lrn_lasso_final <- as_learner(
  po("encode", method = "one-hot") %>>%
  po("imputemean") %>>%
    lrn(
      "regr.cv_glmnet",
      alpha       = 1,
      lambda      = 10^seq(from = -4, to = 2, by = 0.05),
      standardize = TRUE
    )
)

set.seed(67)
rr_lasso_final <- resample(
  task       = tsk_household_final,
  learner    = lrn_lasso_final,
  resampling = resampling
)

lasso_rmse_final <- rr_lasso_final$aggregate(msr("regr.rmse"))
print(paste("LASSO (final features) CV RMSE:", lasso_rmse_final))

# random forest model

# tuner we used
# lrn_rf_tune_final <- as_learner(
#   po("missind") %>>%
#   po("imputehist", affect_columns = selector_type("integer")) %>>%
#   po("imputeoor", affect_columns = selector_type("factor")) %>>%
#     lrn("regr.ranger", 
#       num.threads = 1,
#       num.trees       = to_tune(800, 1500),
#       mtry.ratio      = to_tune(0.2, 0.8),   
#       sample.fraction = to_tune(0.6, 1.0),  
#       min.node.size   = to_tune(1, 10),
#       importance = "impurity"
#     )
# )

set.seed(67)
lrn_rf_tune_final <- as_learner(
  po("missind") %>>%
  po("imputehist", affect_columns = selector_type("integer")) %>>%
  po("imputeoor", affect_columns = selector_type("factor")) %>>%
    lrn("regr.ranger", 
      num.threads = 1,
      num.trees       = 1381,
      mtry.ratio      = 0.2745159,   
      sample.fraction = 0.6580872,  
      min.node.size   = 10,
      importance = "impurity"
    )
)

set.seed(67)
rr_rf_final <- resample(
  task       = tsk_household_final,
  learner    = lrn_rf_tune_final,
  resampling = resampling
)

rf_rmse_final <- rr_rf_final$aggregate(msr("regr.rmse"))
print(paste("RF (final features) CV RMSE:", rf_rmse_final))

# xgboost model

# tuner we used
# set.seed(67)
# lrn_xgb_tune_final <- as_learner(
#   po("encode", method = "one-hot") %>>%
#   po("imputemean") %>>%
#     lrn(
#       "regr.xgboost",
#       nrounds          = to_tune,     
#       max_depth        = to_tune(3, 9),          
#       eta              = to_tune(0.008, 0.1),    
#       subsample        = to_tune(0.65, 0.95),
#       colsample_bytree = to_tune(0.65, 0.95),
#       min_child_weight = to_tune(2, 15),          
#       gamma            = to_tune(0, 0.8)   
#     )
# )


set.seed(67)
lrn_xgb_tune_final <- as_learner(
  po("encode", method = "one-hot") %>>%
  po("imputemean") %>>%
    lrn(
      "regr.xgboost",
      nrounds          = 167,    
      max_depth        = 3,          
      eta              = 0.02251698,    
      subsample        = 0.7214576,
      colsample_bytree = 0.7563982,
      min_child_weight = 5.609415,          
      gamma            = 9.7132525,
      nthread = 1
      )
)

set.seed(67)
rr_xgb_final <- resample(
  task       = tsk_household_final,
  learner    = lrn_xgb_tune_final,
  resampling = resampling
)

xgb_rmse_final <- rr_xgb_final$aggregate(msr("regr.rmse"))
print(paste("XGBoost (final features) CV RMSE:", xgb_rmse_final))

# train on all models 
lrn_ridge_final$train(tsk_household_final)
lrn_lasso_final$train(tsk_household_final)
lrn_rf_tune_final$train(tsk_household_final)
lrn_xgb_tune_final$train(tsk_household_final)

# predict for all models 
ridge_preds_final <- lrn_ridge_final$predict_newdata(test_for_pred_final)
lasso_preds_final <- lrn_lasso_final$predict_newdata(test_for_pred_final)
rf_preds_final    <- lrn_rf_tune_final$predict_newdata(test_for_pred_final)
xgb_preds_final   <- lrn_xgb_tune_final$predict_newdata(test_for_pred_final)


ridge_submission_final <- tibble(
  Survey.ResponseID        = test_for_pred_final$Survey.ResponseID,
  Q.amazon.use.hh.size.num = ridge_preds_final$response
)
write_csv(ridge_submission_final, "prediction_ridge_final_1.csv")

lasso_submission_final <- tibble(
  Survey.ResponseID        = test_for_pred_final$Survey.ResponseID,
  Q.amazon.use.hh.size.num = lasso_preds_final$response
)
write_csv(lasso_submission_final, "prediction_lasso_final_1.csv")

rf_submission_final <- tibble(
  Survey.ResponseID        = test_for_pred_final$Survey.ResponseID,
  Q.amazon.use.hh.size.num = rf_preds_final$response
)
write_csv(rf_submission_final, "prediction_rf_final_1.csv")

xgb_submission_final <- tibble(
  Survey.ResponseID        = test_for_pred_final$Survey.ResponseID,
  Q.amazon.use.hh.size.num = xgb_preds_final$response
)
write_csv(xgb_submission_final, "prediction_xgb_final_1.csv")


```

```{r}
# RMSE comparison
results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Ridge", "LASSO", "Random Forest", "XGBoost"),
  RMSE = c((ridge_rmse_final), (lasso_rmse_final), (rf_rmse_final),(xgb_rmse_final))
)

print(results)
```
